statement.p: Find area of the region under the curve y = 9 - 5 x^2 and above the x-axis.

static.solution:
(Click on the graph for a larger version.)
The area we want is that above the x-axis and under the function. The x-intercepts are where y = 9 - 5 x^2 = 0, which is at x = \pm\sqrt{\frac{9}{5}}, so we need to find \int_{-\sqrt{\frac{9}{5}}}^{\sqrt{\frac{9}{5}}} (9 - 5 x^2) dx \approx 16.099. We can find the area in a number of ways, the easiest of which is to use a graphing calculator.
